name: search-contacts
description: Matches the contacts saved in your Apollo team against keywords (name, email, title or company), sorted and paged. Spends no Apollo credits. Answers each contact's id, name, title, company, email, account id and stage id.

query.description: Keywords to match against saved contacts' names, titles, companies, or email addresses.

sortBy.description: What to sort by: the last activity, the last email opened or clicked, or when the contact was saved (newest).

sortAscending.description: Whether to sort in ascending order. Omit to use Apollo's default.

perPage.description: Maximum contacts to return per page.
